loss_note: labels == input_ids; plain causal-LM cross-entropy, mean over every predicted position (HF shifts internally, so position 0 is context and 1..n-1 are predicted). There is no prompt/response split in this data.
gradient_captured: raw per-document gradient at the CURRENT parameters, before clipping and before the optimiser update

projection.note: count-sketch: one +/-1 per input coordinate; unbiased on inner products, Var = (||x||^2||y||^2 + <x,y>^2)/k to leading order, i.e. the same as a dense Gaussian sketch
